CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION astra_shared_equity_features_20260928_v1.compute_feature_sessions_remediated_v1(p_lo integer, p_hi integer, p_start date, p_end date, p_skip_built boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS SETOF astra_shared_equity_features_20260928_v1.feature_session_cache_remediated_v1
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
SELECT f.*,i.identity_contract_sha256,
 astra_shared_equity_features_20260928_v1.compact_output_hash_remediated_v1(f.source_rows_sha256,i.identity_contract_sha256,f.minute_indices,f.validity_codes,f.dependency_source_observed_at,f.coefficient_values,f.retained_source_rows,f.unaligned_source_rows,f.invalid_ohlc_rows,f.invalid_volume_rows),statement_timestamp()
FROM(WITH scope AS(SELECT u.instrument_key,c.session_date,c.regular_open,c.regular_close FROM reference.alpaca_fixed_window_instruments_v1 u CROSS JOIN market_governance.us_equity_fixed_session_calendar c WHERE u.instrument_key BETWEEN p_lo AND p_hi AND c.session_date BETWEEN p_start AND p_end AND p_lo>=1 AND p_hi<=13277 AND p_hi>=p_lo AND p_hi-p_lo<=99 AND p_start>='2025-09-01' AND p_end<'2026-08-01' AND p_end>=p_start AND p_end-p_start<=31 AND (NOT p_skip_built OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM astra_shared_equity_features_20260928_v1.feature_session_cache_remediated_v1 z WHERE z.instrument_key=u.instrument_key AND z.session_date=c.session_date))), source_all AS MATERIALIZED(
 SELECT s.instrument_key,s.session_date,s.regular_open,s.regular_close,
 b.bar_ts,b.open,b.high,b.low,b.close,b.volume,b.trade_count,b.vwap,b.source_loaded_at,b.loaded_by_job_id,
 (extract(epoch FROM b.bar_ts-s.regular_open)/60)::smallint minute_index,
 b.bar_ts=date_trunc('minute',b.bar_ts)clock_aligned,
 sha256(convert_to(jsonb_build_array(b.instrument_key,b.bar_ts,b.open,b.high,b.low,b.close,b.volume,b.trade_count,b.vwap,b.source_loaded_at,b.loaded_by_job_id)::text,'UTF8'))row_sha256
 FROM scope s JOIN market_fixed_20250901_20260831.alpaca_sip_bars_1m b
 ON b.instrument_key=s.instrument_key AND b.bar_ts>=s.regular_open AND b.bar_ts<s.regular_close
), validated AS MATERIALIZED(
 SELECT *,coalesce(open>0 AND high>0 AND low>0 AND close>0
 AND market_factors_20250901_20260731_v1.finite_float_remediated_v1(open)
 AND market_factors_20250901_20260731_v1.finite_float_remediated_v1(high)
 AND market_factors_20250901_20260731_v1.finite_float_remediated_v1(low)
 AND market_factors_20250901_20260731_v1.finite_float_remediated_v1(close)
 AND high>=greatest(open,close,low)AND low<=least(open,close,high),false)valid_bar,
 coalesce(volume>=0,false)valid_volume_flag,
 lag(minute_index)OVER(PARTITION BY instrument_key,session_date ORDER BY minute_index)prior_minute
 FROM source_all WHERE clock_aligned
), base AS MATERIALIZED(
 SELECT *,CASE WHEN valid_bar THEN close END valid_close,
 CASE WHEN valid_volume_flag THEN volume::float8 END valid_volume,
 CASE WHEN valid_bar AND vwap>0 AND market_factors_20250901_20260731_v1.finite_float_remediated_v1(vwap)THEN vwap END valid_vwap,
 greatest(coalesce(max(minute_index)FILTER(WHERE NOT valid_bar)OVER wu,-1),coalesce(max(minute_index-1)FILTER(WHERE prior_minute IS NULL OR minute_index<>prior_minute+1)OVER wu,-1))last_bad_price,
 greatest(coalesce(max(minute_index)FILTER(WHERE NOT valid_volume_flag)OVER wu,-1),coalesce(max(minute_index-1)FILTER(WHERE prior_minute IS NULL OR minute_index<>prior_minute+1)OVER wu,-1))last_bad_volume
 FROM validated WINDOW wu AS(PARTITION BY instrument_key,session_date ORDER BY minute_index ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
), lagged AS MATERIALIZED(
 SELECT *,minute_index-last_bad_price consecutive_valid_prices,minute_index-last_bad_volume consecutive_valid_volumes,
 lag(valid_close,1)OVER wi lag1,lag(valid_close,5)OVER wi lag5,lag(valid_close,10)OVER wi lag10,
 lag(valid_close,20)OVER wi lag20,lag(valid_close,60)OVER wi lag60,lag(valid_close,120)OVER wi lag120,
 avg(valid_close)OVER w4 sma5,avg(valid_close)OVER w19 sma20,avg(valid_close)OVER w59 sma60,
 avg(valid_volume)OVER w19 vmean20,stddev_samp(valid_volume)OVER w19 vsd20,
 avg(valid_close*valid_volume)OVER w19 dvmean20,
 max(high)FILTER(WHERE valid_bar)OVER w19 hi20,min(low)FILTER(WHERE valid_bar)OVER w19 lo20,
 sum(coalesce(valid_vwap,valid_close)*valid_volume)FILTER(WHERE valid_volume>0 AND coalesce(valid_vwap,valid_close)>0)OVER wu cum_pv,
 sum(valid_volume)FILTER(WHERE valid_volume>0 AND coalesce(valid_vwap,valid_close)>0)OVER wu cum_volume,
 bool_or(valid_vwap IS NULL AND valid_close IS NOT NULL AND valid_volume>0)OVER wu session_vwap_uses_close_proxy,
 max(source_loaded_at)OVER wu dependency_source_observed_at,
 count(source_loaded_at)OVER wu=count(*)OVER wu dependency_receipts_complete,
 count(*)FILTER(WHERE valid_bar)OVER wu=minute_index+1 session_clock_coverage_complete
 FROM base
 WINDOW wi AS(PARTITION BY instrument_key,session_date ORDER BY minute_index),
 w4 AS(PARTITION BY instrument_key,session_date ORDER BY minute_index ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),
 w19 AS(PARTITION BY instrument_key,session_date ORDER BY minute_index ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),
 w59 AS(PARTITION BY instrument_key,session_date ORDER BY minute_index ROWS BETWEEN 59 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),
 wu AS(PARTITION BY instrument_key,session_date ORDER BY minute_index ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
), returns AS(
 SELECT *,CASE WHEN consecutive_valid_prices>=2 AND lag1>0 THEN ln(valid_close/lag1)END logret1 FROM lagged
), rolled AS(
 SELECT *,stddev_samp(logret1)OVER w4 rv5,stddev_samp(logret1)OVER w19 rv20,stddev_samp(logret1)OVER w59 rv60
 FROM returns WINDOW
 w4 AS(PARTITION BY instrument_key,session_date ORDER BY minute_index ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),
 w19 AS(PARTITION BY instrument_key,session_date ORDER BY minute_index ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),
 w59 AS(PARTITION BY instrument_key,session_date ORDER BY minute_index ROWS BETWEEN 59 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
), coefficients AS(
 SELECT instrument_key,session_date,minute_index,dependency_source_observed_at,
 ((CASE WHEN valid_bar THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)+(CASE WHEN valid_volume IS NOT NULL THEN 2 ELSE 0 END)+
 (CASE WHEN valid_vwap IS NOT NULL THEN 4 ELSE 0 END)+(CASE WHEN session_vwap_uses_close_proxy THEN 8 ELSE 0 END)+
 (CASE WHEN dependency_receipts_complete THEN 16 ELSE 0 END)+(CASE WHEN session_clock_coverage_complete THEN 32 ELSE 0 END))::smallint validity_code,
 ARRAY[
 CASE WHEN consecutive_valid_prices>=2 AND lag1>0 THEN valid_close/lag1-1 END,
 CASE WHEN consecutive_valid_prices>=6 AND lag5>0 THEN valid_close/lag5-1 END,
 CASE WHEN consecutive_valid_prices>=11 AND lag10>0 THEN valid_close/lag10-1 END,
 CASE WHEN consecutive_valid_prices>=21 AND lag20>0 THEN valid_close/lag20-1 END,
 CASE WHEN consecutive_valid_prices>=61 AND lag60>0 THEN valid_close/lag60-1 END,
 CASE WHEN consecutive_valid_prices>=121 AND lag120>0 THEN valid_close/lag120-1 END,
 CASE WHEN consecutive_valid_prices>=6 THEN rv5 END,CASE WHEN consecutive_valid_prices>=21 THEN rv20 END,CASE WHEN consecutive_valid_prices>=61 THEN rv60 END,
 CASE WHEN consecutive_valid_prices>=20 AND lo20>0 THEN hi20/lo20-1 END,
 CASE WHEN consecutive_valid_volumes>=20 THEN vmean20 END,CASE WHEN consecutive_valid_volumes>=20 THEN vsd20 END,
 CASE WHEN least(consecutive_valid_prices,consecutive_valid_volumes)>=20 THEN dvmean20 END,
 CASE WHEN consecutive_valid_prices>=5 THEN sma5 END,CASE WHEN consecutive_valid_prices>=20 THEN sma20 END,CASE WHEN consecutive_valid_prices>=60 THEN sma60 END,
 CASE WHEN cum_volume>0 THEN cum_pv/cum_volume END]::float8[] coefficient_values
 FROM rolled
), packed AS(
 SELECT instrument_key,session_date,count(*)::integer aligned_source_rows,
 array_agg(minute_index ORDER BY minute_index)minute_indices,
 array_agg(validity_code ORDER BY minute_index)validity_codes,
 array_agg(dependency_source_observed_at ORDER BY minute_index)dependency_source_observed_at,
 array_agg(coefficient_values ORDER BY minute_index)coefficient_values,
 count(*)FILTER(WHERE(validity_code&1)=0)::integer invalid_ohlc_rows,
 count(*)FILTER(WHERE(validity_code&2)=0)::integer invalid_volume_rows
 FROM coefficients GROUP BY instrument_key,session_date
), source_summary AS(
 SELECT instrument_key,session_date,count(*)::integer retained_source_rows,
 count(*)FILTER(WHERE NOT clock_aligned)::integer unaligned_source_rows,
 min(source_loaded_at)first_source_acquisition,max(source_loaded_at)latest_source_acquisition,
 sha256(string_agg(row_sha256,''::bytea ORDER BY bar_ts))source_rows_sha256
 FROM source_all GROUP BY instrument_key,session_date
)
SELECT s.instrument_key,s.session_date,s.regular_open,s.regular_close,
 (extract(epoch FROM s.regular_close-s.regular_open)/60)::smallint expected_grid_rows,
 coalesce(t.retained_source_rows,0)retained_source_rows,coalesce(t.unaligned_source_rows,0)unaligned_source_rows,
 coalesce(p.aligned_source_rows,0)aligned_source_rows,
 coalesce(p.minute_indices,'{}'::smallint[])minute_indices,coalesce(p.validity_codes,'{}'::smallint[])validity_codes,
 coalesce(p.dependency_source_observed_at,'{}'::timestamptz[])dependency_source_observed_at,
 coalesce(p.coefficient_values,'{}'::float8[])coefficient_values,
 coalesce(p.invalid_ohlc_rows,0)invalid_ohlc_rows,coalesce(p.invalid_volume_rows,0)invalid_volume_rows,
 t.first_source_acquisition,t.latest_source_acquisition,
 coalesce(t.source_rows_sha256,sha256(''::bytea))source_rows_sha256
FROM scope s LEFT JOIN packed p USING(instrument_key,session_date)LEFT JOIN source_summary t USING(instrument_key,session_date)
)f JOIN astra_shared_equity_features_20260928_v1.shared_identity_contract_remediated_v1 i USING(instrument_key,session_date)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION astra_shared_equity_features_20260928_v1.feature_grid_remediated_v1(p_instrument_key integer, p_session_date date, p_decision_ts timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_allow_archived_proxy boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS SETOF astra_shared_equity_features_20260928_v1.feature_minute_remediated_v1
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
WITH requested AS MATERIALIZED(
 SELECT u.instrument_key,cal.session_date,cal.regular_open,cal.regular_close,u.alpaca_asset_id
 FROM reference.alpaca_fixed_window_instruments_v1 u CROSS JOIN market_governance.us_equity_fixed_session_calendar cal
 WHERE u.instrument_key=p_instrument_key AND cal.session_date=p_session_date AND p_session_date>='2025-09-01'AND p_session_date<'2026-08-01'
), source_now AS MATERIALIZED(
 SELECT b.*,sha256(convert_to(jsonb_build_array(b.instrument_key,b.bar_ts,b.open,b.high,b.low,b.close,b.volume,b.trade_count,b.vwap,b.source_loaded_at,b.loaded_by_job_id)::text,'UTF8'))row_sha256
 FROM requested s JOIN market_fixed_20250901_20260831.alpaca_sip_bars_1m b ON b.instrument_key=s.instrument_key AND b.bar_ts>=s.regular_open AND b.bar_ts<s.regular_close
), source_hash AS(
 SELECT coalesce(sha256(string_agg(row_sha256,''::bytea ORDER BY bar_ts)),sha256(''::bytea))source_sha256 FROM source_now
), meta AS MATERIALIZED(
 SELECT s.*,c.instrument_key IS NOT NULL materialized,c.built_at,c.aligned_source_rows,c.unaligned_source_rows,
 c.minute_indices||'{}'::smallint[]cached_minutes,c.validity_codes||'{}'::smallint[]cached_flags,
 c.dependency_source_observed_at||'{}'::timestamptz[]cached_receipts,c.coefficient_values||'{}'::float8[]cached_values,
 i.identity_anchor,i.identity_eligible,i.identity_recorded_at,i.native_source_symbol,i.currency_code,i.internal_instrument_id,i.internal_uuid_matches,
 coalesce(c.source_rows_sha256=h.source_sha256,false)source_version_matches,
 coalesce(c.identity_contract_sha256=i.identity_contract_sha256,false)identity_version_matches,
 coalesce(c.output_sha256=astra_shared_equity_features_20260928_v1.compact_output_hash_remediated_v1(c.source_rows_sha256,c.identity_contract_sha256,c.minute_indices,c.validity_codes,c.dependency_source_observed_at,c.coefficient_values,c.retained_source_rows,c.unaligned_source_rows,c.invalid_ohlc_rows,c.invalid_volume_rows),false)output_hash_matches
 FROM requested s LEFT JOIN astra_shared_equity_features_20260928_v1.feature_session_cache_remediated_v1 c USING(instrument_key,session_date)
 LEFT JOIN astra_shared_equity_features_20260928_v1.shared_identity_contract_remediated_v1 i USING(instrument_key,session_date) CROSS JOIN source_hash h
), observed AS MATERIALIZED(
 SELECT n ordinal,m.cached_minutes[n]slot,m.cached_flags[n]flags,m.cached_receipts[n]receipt,
 ARRAY[m.cached_values[n][1],m.cached_values[n][2],m.cached_values[n][3],m.cached_values[n][4],m.cached_values[n][5],m.cached_values[n][6],m.cached_values[n][7],m.cached_values[n][8],m.cached_values[n][9],m.cached_values[n][10],m.cached_values[n][11],m.cached_values[n][12],m.cached_values[n][13],m.cached_values[n][14],m.cached_values[n][15],m.cached_values[n][16],m.cached_values[n][17]]coefficient_row
 FROM meta m CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_subscripts(m.cached_minutes,1)n
), grid0 AS(
 SELECT m.*,g.slot,m.regular_open+g.slot*interval'1 minute'bar_start,m.regular_open+(g.slot+1)*interval'1 minute'bar_end,
 o.ordinal,o.flags,o.receipt,o.coefficient_row,
 max(o.ordinal)OVER(ORDER BY g.slot ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)prefix_ordinal
 FROM meta m CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(0,(extract(epoch FROM m.regular_close-m.regular_open)/60)::integer-1)g(slot)
 LEFT JOIN observed o ON o.slot=g.slot
), grid AS(
 SELECT g.*,b.open raw_open,b.high raw_high,b.low raw_low,b.close raw_close,b.volume raw_volume,b.trade_count raw_trade_count,b.vwap raw_vwap,
 p.coefficient_row[17]observed_session_vwap,p.flags prefix_flags,p.receipt dependency_receipt,
 (g.source_version_matches AND g.identity_version_matches AND g.output_hash_matches)version_consistent,
 m.instrument_id IS NOT NULL micro_present,m.trade_count micro_trades,m.quote_count micro_quotes,m.avg_spread_bps micro_spread,
 m.last_bid_price,m.last_ask_price,m.last_bid_size,m.last_ask_size,m.last_trade_price,m.buy_volume,m.sell_volume,
 greatest(m.inserted_at,m.updated_at)micro_version_recorded_at,
 m.inserted_at IS NOT NULL AND m.updated_at IS NOT NULL micro_version_time_complete
 FROM grid0 g LEFT JOIN source_now b ON b.bar_ts=g.bar_start
 LEFT JOIN observed p ON p.ordinal=g.prefix_ordinal
 LEFT JOIN public.equity_microstructure_1m m ON m.provider='alpaca'AND m.instrument_id=g.internal_instrument_id AND m.ts=g.bar_start
), usable AS(
 SELECT *,coalesce(version_consistent AND ordinal IS NOT NULL AND(flags&1)=1,false)price_valid,
 coalesce(version_consistent AND ordinal IS NOT NULL AND(flags&2)=2,false)volume_valid,
 coalesce(version_consistent AND ordinal IS NOT NULL AND(flags&4)=4,false)provider_vwap_valid,
 coalesce(version_consistent AND micro_present AND(p_decision_ts IS NULL OR p_allow_archived_proxy OR(micro_version_time_complete AND micro_version_recorded_at<=p_decision_ts)),false)micro_usable,
 coalesce(last_bid_price>0 AND last_ask_price>=last_bid_price AND market_factors_20250901_20260731_v1.finite_float_remediated_v1(last_bid_price)AND market_factors_20250901_20260731_v1.finite_float_remediated_v1(last_ask_price),false)quote_pair_valid
 FROM grid
), final_rows AS(
 SELECT *,count(*)FILTER(WHERE NOT price_valid)OVER(ORDER BY slot ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)::integer missing20
 FROM usable
)
SELECT session_date,'alpaca'::text,internal_instrument_id,native_source_symbol,'sip'::text,
 bar_start,bar_end,bar_end+interval'1 second',slot,slot,(extract(epoch FROM regular_close-bar_end)/60)::integer,
 CASE WHEN price_valid THEN raw_open END,CASE WHEN price_valid THEN raw_high END,CASE WHEN price_valid THEN raw_low END,CASE WHEN price_valid THEN raw_close END,
 CASE WHEN volume_valid THEN raw_volume::float8 END,CASE WHEN version_consistent AND raw_trade_count>=0 THEN raw_trade_count END,
 CASE WHEN provider_vwap_valid THEN raw_vwap END,
 coalesce(ordinal IS NOT NULL,false),price_valid,
 CASE WHEN price_valid AND volume_valid AND currency_code='USD' THEN raw_close*raw_volume END,
 CASE WHEN provider_vwap_valid AND volume_valid AND currency_code='USD'THEN raw_vwap*raw_volume END,
 CASE WHEN version_consistent THEN coefficient_row[1]END,CASE WHEN version_consistent THEN coefficient_row[2]END,CASE WHEN version_consistent THEN coefficient_row[3]END,
 CASE WHEN version_consistent THEN coefficient_row[4]END,CASE WHEN version_consistent THEN coefficient_row[5]END,CASE WHEN version_consistent THEN coefficient_row[6]END,
 CASE WHEN version_consistent THEN coefficient_row[7]END,CASE WHEN version_consistent THEN coefficient_row[8]END,CASE WHEN version_consistent THEN coefficient_row[9]END,
 CASE WHEN price_valid THEN(raw_high-raw_low)/raw_open END,CASE WHEN price_valid THEN(raw_close-raw_open)/raw_open END,
 CASE WHEN price_valid THEN(raw_high-greatest(raw_open,raw_close))/raw_open END,CASE WHEN price_valid THEN(least(raw_open,raw_close)-raw_low)/raw_open END,
 CASE WHEN version_consistent THEN coefficient_row[10]END,CASE WHEN version_consistent THEN coefficient_row[11]END,
 CASE WHEN volume_valid AND coefficient_row[11]>0 THEN raw_volume/coefficient_row[11]END,
 CASE WHEN volume_valid AND coefficient_row[12]>0 THEN(raw_volume-coefficient_row[11])/coefficient_row[12]END,
 CASE WHEN version_consistent AND currency_code='USD'THEN coefficient_row[13]END,
 CASE WHEN version_consistent THEN coefficient_row[14]END,CASE WHEN version_consistent THEN coefficient_row[15]END,CASE WHEN version_consistent THEN coefficient_row[16]END,
 CASE WHEN version_consistent THEN observed_session_vwap END,
 CASE WHEN price_valid AND provider_vwap_valid THEN(raw_close/raw_vwap-1)*10000 END,
 CASE WHEN price_valid AND observed_session_vwap>0 THEN(raw_close/observed_session_vwap-1)*10000 END,
 CASE WHEN price_valid AND coefficient_row[15]>0 THEN(raw_close/coefficient_row[15]-1)*10000 END,
 CASE WHEN version_consistent AND coefficient_row[14]>0 AND coefficient_row[15]>0 THEN(coefficient_row[14]/coefficient_row[15]-1)*10000 END,
 missing20,CASE WHEN slot>=19 THEN(20-missing20)::float8/20 END,
 micro_usable,CASE WHEN micro_usable AND micro_trades>=0 THEN micro_trades END,CASE WHEN micro_usable AND micro_quotes>=0 THEN micro_quotes END,
 CASE WHEN micro_usable AND micro_spread>=0 AND market_factors_20250901_20260731_v1.finite_float_remediated_v1(micro_spread)THEN micro_spread END,
 CASE WHEN micro_usable AND quote_pair_valid THEN(last_ask_price-last_bid_price)/((last_ask_price+last_bid_price)/2)*10000 END,
 CASE WHEN micro_usable AND buy_volume>=0 AND sell_volume>=0 AND market_factors_20250901_20260731_v1.finite_float_remediated_v1(buy_volume)AND market_factors_20250901_20260731_v1.finite_float_remediated_v1(sell_volume)AND buy_volume+sell_volume>0 THEN(buy_volume-sell_volume)/(buy_volume+sell_volume)END,
 CASE WHEN micro_usable AND quote_pair_valid AND last_bid_size>=0 AND last_ask_size>=0 AND market_factors_20250901_20260731_v1.finite_float_remediated_v1(last_bid_size)AND market_factors_20250901_20260731_v1.finite_float_remediated_v1(last_ask_size)AND last_bid_size+last_ask_size>0 THEN(last_bid_size-last_ask_size)/(last_bid_size+last_ask_size)END,
 CASE WHEN micro_usable AND quote_pair_valid AND last_trade_price>0 AND market_factors_20250901_20260731_v1.finite_float_remediated_v1(last_trade_price)THEN(last_trade_price/((last_ask_price+last_bid_price)/2)-1)*10000 END,
 jsonb_build_object('source_row_present',ordinal IS NOT NULL,'feature_session_materialized',materialized,'ohlc_valid',price_valid,'volume_valid',volume_valid,'exact_clock_grid',true,'missing_bars_20m',missing20,'microstructure_source_present',micro_present,'microstructure_available',micro_usable,'identity_eligible',identity_eligible,'internal_uuid_matches',internal_uuid_matches,'dated_native_symbol_missing',native_source_symbol IS NULL,'source_version_matches',source_version_matches,'identity_version_matches',identity_version_matches,'output_hash_matches',output_hash_matches,'unaligned_source_rows_excluded',unaligned_source_rows,'session_vwap_close_fallback',coalesce((prefix_flags&8)=8,false),'session_vwap_uses_observed_volumes_only',true,'prefix_source_receipts_complete',coalesce((prefix_flags&16)=16,false),'scheduled_session_price_coverage_complete_so_far',coalesce((prefix_flags&32)=32,false),'missing_clock_slots_are_not_assumed_provider_eligible',true,'corporate_action_adjustment_status','RAW_WITHIN_SESSION_NO_ACTION_ADJUSTMENT','outcome_independent',true,'historical_use_mode',CASE WHEN p_decision_ts IS NULL THEN 'DIAGNOSTIC_RETAINED_RELEASE'WHEN p_allow_archived_proxy THEN 'ARCHIVED_FINAL_BAR_BOUND_RETROSPECTIVE_IDENTITY'ELSE 'KNOWN_ACQUIRED_AND_BUILT_BY_CUTOFF'END,'original_historical_receipt_recovered',false),
 instrument_key,alpaca_asset_id,identity_anchor,currency_code,dependency_receipt,identity_recorded_at,built_at,micro_version_recorded_at,
 coalesce(identity_eligible AND version_consistent AND price_valid,false),false,'compact_intraday_float64_v1'::text
FROM final_rows
WHERE p_decision_ts IS NULL OR(
 bar_end+interval'1 second'<=p_decision_ts AND identity_eligible AND version_consistent AND price_valid
 AND(p_allow_archived_proxy OR((prefix_flags&16)=16 AND dependency_receipt<=p_decision_ts AND identity_recorded_at<=p_decision_ts AND built_at<=p_decision_ts))
)
ORDER BY bar_start
$function$
